answer: Reaching the onyx of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on time-locked escrow with arbitration fallback. The signal lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the terrace is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a pragmatic engineering perspective, trade-offs first register, it stays short.
